### The Spirit of Control
Author: Dr. Michael Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-june-22-11605039.html
Passage: 2 Kings 4:38-44
Points:
- Elisha demonstrated faith that God would sustain the prophets even during a severe famine.
- Human attempts to take control and improve upon God's provision can lead to spiritual and practical disaster, mirroring the poisonous gourds in the pot.
- When human meddling creates ruin, God still retains the power to intervene and make things right.
- The flour thrown into the stew pictures Jesus Christ, crushed on the cross to remove the deadly poison of sin.
- Believers are called to surrender self-reliance and the urge to control outcomes, trusting God's perfect plan.
